post.description: Enforces valid state transition in the Option C regulatory decision lifecycle.

Stage B — Retrieves official legal evidence and binds exact passages to case.
Halts with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE if no matching authoritative sources exist.

Stages C & D — Runs multi-agent legal investigation, creates canonical decision record (VCP-1),
and verifies the sealed record against zero-trust audit rules.
Stage J — Exports complete audit package and verifies it offline using zero-trust rules.

post.description:
Executes the complete Appendix A end-to-end benchmark workflow:
1. Initializes legal corpus & default agents.
2. Creates Case (A.1 AI-enabled customer analytics).
3. Runs multi-agent investigation & hybrid verification (A.2).
4. Creates Prediction Market & commits/reveals forecasts with cryptographic hashes (A.3).
5. Opens Evidence Bounty, submits verified authority, and settles simulated credits (A.4).
6. Resolves and settles Prediction Market with Brier scoring.
7. Generates comprehensive 10-section final report.
